name: ed3d-orchestrate
description: EXPERIMENTAL. Polytoken-style orchestration loop for Copilot CLI: scout-sweep research fanout, plan-review gate, builder fanout, and adversarial tumble-dryer review rounds with owner-scoped parent stop/state isolation, provenance-aware reconciliation, and bounded recovery. Child write enforcement remains review-wide because preToolUse lacks a parent owner field; the handoff gate is protocol-only (Branch B).
